name: Kashiba (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kashiba city emblem in green: a winged device with a pointed top enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kashiba, a city in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 28 February 2020; the emblem dates from 11 August 1959.

features.role: Kashiba city emblem — a winged device with a pointed top enclosing a stylised character
